Mono Portable Bluetooth Speaker Wireless Charging

Features

Play, Light Up, and Wirelessly Charge: Experience seamless functionality as our Mono Portable Bluetooth Speaker allows you to play your favourite tunes, light up your space with captivating LED lights, and conveniently wirelessly charge your devices.
6+ Modes Light: : Set the mood with over 6 dynamic lighting modes, from vibrant beats to smooth transitions, or adjust the brightness with the dimmer function to suit any ambience.
360° Room Filling Sound: Immerse yourself in powerful 5W dynamic sound that fills every corner of your room, thanks to our speaker’s innovative design and TWS (True Wireless Stereo) technology.
Premium Design: Crafted with premium natural wood and ABS plastic, our Mono Portable Bluetooth Speaker boasts a sleek and sophisticated look that complements any interior décor. The translucent case adds a touch of elegance, while real wood legs provide stability and style.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.
